rationale: Z13/Z16/Z18 (deep review, 2026-09-28). The declared-type graph is zig's LARGEST UNAUDITED relationship class: the differential compares only `calls` and `uses` for this lane, so a whole class of edges had no second opinion (that is Z14, the finding this fixture's sibling gate work addresses). Its leaf was chosen by walking every `identifier` under the declaration, dropping the first as the name and taking the last — and the grammar never agreed to that story: it hands the type over as a FIELD (`parameter.type` 78,895, `container_field.type` 49,424, `variable_declaration.type` 43,949, `function_declaration.type` 37,129 in the pinned corpora). The walk was wrong wherever a declaration has a DEFAULT VALUE, because a value contributes identifiers after the type: `size: Size = .byte` published a reference to `byte` (an enum member) and never to `Size`; `normal = @sizeOf(u8)` published `u8`. It was also wrong where a type NAMES nothing: an anonymous struct type in a parameter position has fields, not a name, so the last identifier under it was a FIELD name (`references -> FLAG`); an error set is unnamed, and `!T` keeps its dependency in the `ok` half, not in a member of the set (`fn f() error{A}!u32` published `-> A`). And the class was one position short: the family declares four (field, parameter, return, local) and the collector covered three. Z18: the one regex this analyzer carried sat on this path, where its receiver can only be an `identifier` node's text — so on a plain identifier it was provably a no-op, and on a QUOTED identifier it corrupted a legitimate name (`@"zig lib"` -> `@"ziglib"`; 1,916 of the corpora's 34,132 quoted identifiers carry a character from its junk class). #924 E half (a7368a80) has since ruled that @"@…"@ is quoting SYNTAX and the name is its content, so these rows carry the bare name — the two rulings together are what make a quoted declaration resolvable instead of mangled. The counts are measurements (script/m14/tmp/zigw-decltype.ts, zigw-typedleaf.ts); the expectations are derived from the grammar's field and the Zig reference.
